title: 艾瑞森真空胎风r1初体验，对比gp5000str
notes: Owner post (edited 2026-10-20): the STORM R1 tubeless gripped clearly better than a GP5000 S TR in dry cornering and felt comfortable, but weighed about 20 g more at 28C and felt slower in an uncontrolled road comparison. Commenters: one found it too stiff and said it fishtailed on fast descents; one slipped once when standing on the pedals; one front burst on a pothole in a race; clincher owners reported 6,000 km for a front and under 2,000 km for a rear.
